premise: The pod brings one seed and a note from a child on Earth — please grow this on the Moon; planted in the greenhouse, it takes its time, and becomes the seedling everyone knows.
inspiration: 'The Empty Pot' (Chinese folk tale), turned: this time the seed does grow — it just takes four anxious days.
lesson: Some things are worth waiting for.

en-US.title: The Seed from Earth
en-US.text: {supply-pod:enter} The supply pod popped open {supply-pod:live} with a puff of cold air. Inside was a tiny envelope, and inside that, one seed. And a note, in wobbly letters: Please grow this on the Moon. {greenhouse:enter} So they planted it in the greenhouse, {greenhouse:live hold} under the violet grow-lights. {engineer:enter} {engineer:face happy} Engineer checked on it every morning. Day one: nothing. Day two: nothing. Day three… {engineer:face sad} [sighs] still nothing. What if it never grows? {greenhouse:pulse} [pause] Day four. {engineer:face surprised} [gasps] A green tip, poking up out of the soil! {seedling:enter} The seedling! Its leaves opened, {seedling:live hold} reaching for the light. {engineer:face happy} {engineer:hop x2} They took its picture and sent it home. {seedling:glow} [happily] And somewhere on Earth, a grin grew as wide as the Moon.

es-ES.title: La semilla de la Tierra
es-ES.text: {supply-pod:enter} La cápsula de carga se {supply-pod:live} abrió con un soplo de aire frío. Dentro había un sobrecito, y dentro del sobrecito, una semilla. Y una nota, con letra temblorosa: Por favor, haz que crezca en la Luna. {greenhouse:enter} Así que la plantaron en el invernadero, {greenhouse:live hold} bajo las luces violetas. {engineer:enter} {engineer:face happy} Ingeniera iba a verla cada mañana. Día uno: nada. Día dos: nada. Día tres… {engineer:face sad} [sighs] nada todavía. ¿Y si no crece nunca? {greenhouse:pulse} [pause] Día cuatro. {engineer:face surprised} [gasps] ¡Una puntita verde asomando de la tierra! ¡El {seedling:enter} brote! Sus hojas se abrieron, {seedling:live hold} buscando la luz. {engineer:face happy} {engineer:hop x2} Le hicieron una foto y la enviaron a casa. {seedling:glow} [happily] Y en algún lugar de la Tierra, una sonrisa creció tan grande como la Luna.

hiss.prompt: a sealed lid unlatching with a gentle pressurised hiss and a soft pop
